name: lpqi_spad64_i2cass_nextgen
label: LPQI-Pathfinder next IMSE-LPQI 64x64 SPAD array (microlenses)
sources: F. Prada (LPQI PI), email to P. Nugent 2026-10-07: sensor data for both LPQI-Pathfinder detectors and the filter set
Quintana, Gonzalez-de-Rivera, Lopez-Buedo & Prada 2026, Sensors 26, 5757 (doi:10.3390/s26185757): the LPQI-Pathfinder 64 x 64 I2CASS/IMSE SPAD array and its AER readout
notes: PDE 0.50 flat over 400-550 nm: ~100 % fill factor (25 % native + microlenses) x the 75 % peak PDP at 425 nm of the Sensors paper, taken as a flat 50 % (assumed); the PDP drops to 20 % at 650 nm (linear between 550 and 650 nm here, 20 % beyond -- the H-alpha filter sees 0.19).
Timing 500 ps FWHM: the White Rabbit time-stamping target, not measured.
n_pixels 4: ~1 arcsec seeing on 0.5 arcsec pixels.
Dead time, dark counts and the 6.7e6 cps capture ceiling inherited from the published array.
